Our services enable businesses to hire, manage, and pay employees internationally with ease. We are committed to providing seamless and efficient solutions to our clients and fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment for our team. Position Overview RecruitGo is seeking a Creative professional to take ownership of the creative output by producing high-quality branded content across social media and internal documents. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design and branding, excels in Canva, copywriting, and social media management, and is confident in creating engaging visual content while maintaining brand consistency. Responsibilities This is a creative-first role. We have an established brand and a growing need for consistent, high-quality content across social media channels and internal documents. We want someone who can take ownership of the creative output - not just execute briefs, but bring design instinct and a strong eye for branding. Strong copywriting skills across captions, event copy, member features, and short-form content. Ability to write in Cabal's established brand voice and follow our internal style guide. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design and branding, excels in Canva, copywriting, and social media management, and is confident in creating engaging visual content while maintaining brand consistency.
